title: The Birth of Roy Cohn: Architect of Trumpism
description_short: The Birth of Roy Cohn: Architect of Trumpism
description_medium: On February 20, 1927, Roy Cohn was born in New York to Judge Albert C. Cohn and Dora Cohn. He would grow up to become one of the most notoriously corrupt and ruthless attorneys in New York City history. Decades later, Cohn would become the defining mentor to a young Donald Trump, teaching him the dark arts of total legal warfare: always attack, never apologize, and claim victory regardless of the facts. Cohn’s influence laid the structural foundation for the authoritarian tactics Trump would later deploy in the White House.
description_long: Roy Cohn was born in New York on February 20, 1927. The account also describes him as a mentor to Donald Trump and says he taught Trump a particular approach to litigation. Cohn’s birth in 1927 predates his later legal career and relationship with Donald Trump by decades. Cohn is often described as a mentor to Trump, but the specific tactics he conveyed and their effect on Trump’s later legal strategy are not established. The claim that Cohn founded “Trumpism” therefore goes beyond the facts described here. A reliable biography tracing their relationship and identifying the specific tactics Cohn conveyed is needed before the title’s claim about his influence can be established.
